ctx.x: I don't remember what I did with Victor but when I started with them --

Paul Howard's Quality Serenaders with the great Los Angeles band, that recorded some 11 sides for Victor about 1930. Howard, now the popular secretary of the Los Angeles Colored Local 767 AFof M says that the group was really a cooperative affair and used his name because he was manager. The group originated in 1923 as the Quality Four, for a job at the Red Onion Cafe on Central Avenue. It included Leon Halpert (phonetic) Herriford.
